DTO.name: TerminalInputStateDTO

DTO.MATH: 24 + 12 + 12 + 8 + 4 + 4 = 64 bytes. No Pack=1. No properties. No managed references.

DTO.name: TerminalInputGpuStateDTO

DTO.MATH: 8 + 4 + 4 + 16 = 32 bytes. This is the `_TerminalInputStates` shader ABI; 64-byte CPU AUP rows are not uploaded verbatim.
